description: Test cases for chat-model-ref helper functions in a TypeScript project using Vitest. The file imports helper functions and test data, then defines a series of unit tests to verify their behavior related to chat model representation, resolution, and catalog matching.

methods.name: buildChatModelOption
methods.description: Builds a provider-qualified option object with value and label for a chat model catalog entry.

methods.name: createChatModelOverride
methods.description: Creates a chat model override object from a raw override string.

methods.name: formatChatModelDisplay
methods.description: Formats a chat model reference into a display label, with provider if available.

methods.name: normalizeChatModelOverrideValue
methods.description: Normalizes the override value based on catalog matches, resolving ambiguities.

methods.name: resolveChatModelOverride
methods.description: Determines the source and normalized value of a chat model override, indicating if it is from catalog or raw.

methods.name: resolvePreferredServerChatModel
methods.description: Selects the preferred chat model for a server, favoring catalog match over server provider when appropriate.

methods.name: resolveServerChatModelValue
methods.description: Resolves a server's chat model value to a fully qualified model reference.
